description: Machine format (wr.event.v1, testnet): one sealed event brief envelope by id; version optional (default: latest version). Use event_briefs_list first if you do not have a brief id. Without version, returns the highest-numbered version of the brief; with version, exactly that version. An unknown id or version returns an error; if the store file is absent on this deployment, it returns {brief: null, note}. Returns the full sealed envelope. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).

id.description: Brief id, as returned by event_briefs_list.

name: event_brief_get
